sample_semantics.sampled_quadrat: at least one species row in the quadrat has finite numeric Percent_Cover
sample_semantics.focal_cover: numeric Zostera marina Percent_Cover when present; otherwise 0 only when the same sampled quadrat has a numeric Ruppia maritima record
sample_semantics.unsampled_quadrat: no numeric species cover; excluded and never converted to zero

annual_state.station_presence: at least one sampled quadrat has focal_cover > 0
annual_state.station_frequency: fraction of sampled quadrats with focal_cover > 0
annual_state.multiple_visits_same_station_year: pool all sampled quadrats across visits within year; report survey count

trend_estimands.primary: within-station year slope for focal mean cover and focal frequency, pooled by sum(Sxy)/sum(Sxx), separately by park
trend_estimands.secondary: within-station linear-probability slope for recorded presence, separately by park
trend_estimands.uncertainty: 5000-cluster bootstrap resamples of stable stations within park

cross_scale_boundary.interpretation: Tier-2 estimates bay-wide/random-station change; Tier-3 estimates quantitative change inside repeatedly observed persistent transects. Concordant negative trends indicate contraction/thinning can coexist; discordance indicates scale-specific degradation.

claim_boundary: This is observational post-hoc ecological analysis, not prospective predictive validation.
Do not interpret Percent_Cover decline as demographic extinction.
Do not infer nutrient or climate causation from temporal slopes.
Do not convert unsampled NA stations/quadrats to absence.
